capabilities: open a configured homepage file on startup
restore all files open at the last close
redirect new tabs and Ctrl+T to the homepage
follow the homepage file when it is renamed or moved
switch the interface between Chinese and English
disambiguation: Despite the plural name, v2.0.0 supports only a single homepage; the multi-profile layouts and weekday/time routing of v1.x were removed.
extras: Enabling it alongside the Homepage plugin causes both to fight over startup behavior; the settings page shows a conflict warning when Homepage is detected. README is bilingual (Chinese/English).
intentEvidence: 启动拦截思路借鉴 mirnovov/obsidian-homepage（MIT），独立实现，定位不同
problem: Obsidian's native startup opens no fixed entry point, and there is no built-in one-click restore of the files open when the app last closed or a homepage in new tabs.
